audioDescription: Silent. No audio track; intentional silence for a style preview.
limitations: Illustrative granular appearance only: sand is a GLSL density field built from authored Canvas 2D masks, not a granular physics simulation.
Backlight transmission is approximated as mix(#3A291B, lit field, exp(-3.4*density)); no real light scattering.

Scene-dependent palette: cool blue-white light table (#E3ECEF field, #EEF4F5 centre glow, #CBD8DC edge vignette) chosen for a technical 'connected system' subject; dark sand #3A291B unchanged. The prior #F5E3B5 warm swatch was an example, not an approved restriction.
Table glow, vignette and mottling are static procedural approximations of a lightbox diffuser; they never change over time.
Speckled sand edges come from a per-pixel hash threshold; scrape ridges are approximated from mip-blurred scrape coverage.
Grain is a fixed seeded screen-space hash (stationary), not true grain-size variation.
STYLE.json defines no tech.preview_recipes; the preview demonstrates the base implementation plus source-frame lessons (stray grains before a shape, sequential build, still final hold).
Source-frame evidence covers only seconds 1-8 of one reference video and shows no scraping; scraping behaviour follows STYLE.json, not the source.

Canvas 2D only bakes textures at load; Three.js is bundled locally with esbuild as three.bundle.js. Copy is HTML Georgia italic in #3A291B on the lit field (>= 9.5:1 contrast even at the vignette edge).
